recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated close-up portrait of a male figure in urban attire, featuring a gritty, textured finish and bold, distressed display typography layered over the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's intense gaze directed at the viewer
Clasped hands creating a triangular base for the composition
Typography framing the subject at the top and bottom-right
High-key highlights against deep, crushed shadows
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or concrete-like texture overlay
Bold, blocky sans-serif typography with weathering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, subject fills approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white watch on the wrist.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top text down to the eyes, following the arms to the clasped hands, ending at the bottom-right title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and text occupy most of the frame, with a blurred urban background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for highlights, jewelry, and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and background depth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to blown-out white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Top text features horizontal shearing and erosion
Bottom text features a custom underline bar integrated into the 'n' and 'p' descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a weathered, flat top display and a beveled, metallic bottom title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the top text.
Offers the square, urban feel for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a man in a black t-shirt and baseball cap, hands clasped in front of his face. Apply a heavy film grain and concrete texture overlay. The lighting should be dramatic, coming from above, creating deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, distressed white sans-serif text at the top. Add a metallic-beveled title in the bottom right with a thick horizontal bar underlining the first word.

verificationChecks: Is the texture gritty and visible across the whole frame?
Does the text have a weathered, distressed appearance?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Check for blown-out highlights on the face and watch.
Ensure text is legible despite the distress texture.
Verify the 'triangular' composition of the hands and head.
Confirm the background is sufficiently blurred to keep focus on the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochromatic urban portrait with heavy grit textures and distressed, bold geometric typography for a street-inspired aesthetic.
